table.title: Ordinary Publications by Subjects
transcriber_notes: Printed in two tiers (Literature..Law, then Medical..Total incl. others) with the same year stubs; merged into one row per year. No 1933 or 1934 rows are printed (years run 1932, 1935-1939).
1937 Music: middle digit ambiguous between 5 and 6 (953 or 963) — left blank.
Law column is printed in the gutter, heavily compressed: 574, 774, 876 read; 1937-1939 left blank (appear to read approximately 835, 833/839, 913 in order, digits not certain).
1936 Social Problem 1,252 and 1938 Industry 1,363: final/middle digit partly broken but legible.
Total incl. others column (gutter): 1937 printed '30,7 2' with a digit missing — left blank.

Total incl. others column: seven figures are printed for six years — 22,104; 30,347; 31,996; 30,7?2; 29,644; then 28,054 (in the gap before the 1939 row) and 29,46? (level with the 1939 row, last digit unclear). It is unclear which belongs to 1939, so 1939 total is left blank. (Table 3 gives ordinary publications 1938 29,466 and 1939 28,054; the 1938 total here reads 29,644.)
Total is incl. others, so parts cannot reconcile exactly; for information the listed subjects sum to less than the total where both are readable (checked below).
1932: listed subjects sum to 17,732 vs Total incl. others 22,104
1935: listed subjects sum to 23,291 vs Total incl. others 30,347
1936: listed subjects sum to 27,092 vs Total incl. others 31,996
